entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Marc Bourgery was a French medical doctor and anatomist who was a native of Orléans. Within 20 years, along with the artist Nicolas Henri Jacob, he created the comprehensive anatomy textbook Traité complet de l’anatomie de l’homme.
